checklist_items.label: PhilGEPS Certificate of Platinum Registration & Membership (All Pages)
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Sec. 23 & IRR Eligibility Class "A" Legal/Technical
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Must be valid and current on the date of bid opening. Verify that Annex "A" (Mayor’s Permit, Tax Clearance, Audited FS, PCAB) has no expired dates.

checklist_items.label: Valid PCAB License & Registration for the Size Range of the Contract
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Infrastructure Contractor Eligibility
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Check the Invitation to Bid (ITB) for the required PCAB License Category (e.g., Category B / Medium A) and make sure your license covers this project size.

checklist_items.label: Statement of All Ongoing Government & Private Construction Contracts + SLCC
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Technical Capability (Single Largest Completed Contract >= 50% of ABC)
checklist_items.beginner_tip: List all unfinished contracts and attach your Single Largest Completed Contract (SLCC) of similar nature worth at least 50% of the ABC.

checklist_items.label: Net Financial Contracting Capacity (NFCC) Computation >= ABC
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Financial Eligibility (NFCC = [(CA - CL) x 15] - Ongoing Contracts)
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Formula: ((Current Assets minus Current Liabilities) × 15) minus value of all outstanding/ongoing works. Your NFCC must be at least equal to the ABC!

checklist_items.label: Bid Security (Bid Securing Declaration or 2% Cash/Bank Guarantee or 5% Surety Bond)
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Sec. 27 Bid Security
checklist_items.beginner_tip: A notarized Bid Securing Declaration (BSD) is free and accepted by most procuring entities, or you can post a 2% Bank Guarantee / 5% Surety Bond.

checklist_items.label: Organizational Chart, Key Personnel (Project Manager, Materials Engineer, Safety Officer) & Major Equipment Pledge
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Technical Component - Project Requirements
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Attach PRC IDs, accredited Materials Engineer certificate, DOLE-accredited Safety Officer certificate, and proof of ownership/lease of pledged equipment.

checklist_items.label: Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement (OSS)
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 GPPB Standard Form OSS
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Must use the latest GPPB-prescribed template, signed by the authorized representative with valid government ID and Secretary’s Certificate / SPA.

checklist_items.label: Signed Financial Bid Form (Total Bid Price in Words & Figures <= ABC)
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Second Envelope - Financial Component
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Any bid price above the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) is automatically disqualified at opening. Double-check words vs. figures!

checklist_items.label: Priced Bill of Quantities (BOQ) & Detailed Estimates (DUPA)
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Financial Component - Detailed Unit Price Analysis
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Show direct costs (Materials, Labor, Equipment) plus indirect costs (OCM, Contractor’s Profit, and 5% VAT) for every pay item.

checklist_items.label: Cash Flow by Quarter & Payment Schedule
checklist_items.ra12009_clause: RA 12009 Financial Envelope S-Curve & Cash Flow
checklist_items.beginner_tip: Break down projected quarterly accomplishment and billing schedule across the contract duration.
